This is perhaps an enigmatical allusion to the critical circumstances connected with the history, for which compare <reference osisRef="1Sam.22.1">1Sa 22:1</reference>; <reference osisRef="1Sam.26.1-1Sam.26.3">26:1-3</reference>. This explanation suits the fifty-eighth and fifty-ninth also. Asaph uses it for the seventy-fifth, in the scope of which there is allusion to some emergency. Michtam--(See on <reference osisRef="Ps.16.1">Psa 16:1</reference>, title).
